mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Temperatures are sitting at 45 degrees near Badger Prairie County Park under a lovely waxing crescent moon. Please note that while the ISS is passing overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Looking ahead, our overnight low will drop to 35 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

In city news, the Municipal Court reminds residents that many traffic citations can be paid without a court appearance via their online portal, though O W I cases still require an appointment. Additionally, candidates for the 2027 Spring Election can now pick up registration packets, with forms due back by January 5, 2027.

We have a busy schedule today with Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Looking forward to tomorrow, you can catch Trivia Night at The Mill, Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory, and ART House 360 events.
Taking a look at the police report from October 25, officers were dispatched to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they arrested a 40-year-old man for a first offence O W I.

Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently open, but please keep in mind they close at 10:00 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
